models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Main actor table for registered customer accounts with email/password authentication credentials. This table serves as the canonical identity record for customers, enabling authentication, session management, and ownership of orders, reviews, and wishlists. Customers are distinct actors with login capability and their own session lifecycle. Profile fields like display_name and phone_number are optional and not part of authentication.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for login and authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name shown to other users. May be null if not set.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Optional phone number for contact purposes. May be null if not provided during registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the customer account. Updated when any profile field is modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was logically deleted. If null, account is active. Preserves order history and review data after deletion per 02-user-actors.md.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for customer authentication with access and refresh tokens. This table logs each login event, stores the client's connection context (IP, referrer), and tracks session expiration for security.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who initiated this session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client's IP address at login time.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where login occurred.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header from the client's browser.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Always set to 30 minutes after created_at for access token, 30 days after for refresh token. Never null for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for customer account recovery. Each token is single-use and expires after 2 hours. This table exists to support the authentication flow for customer actors, allowing secure account recovery via email link.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's account requesting password reset. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Randomly generated cryptographic token for password reset link. Must be unique and single-use.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when this reset token will expire (always 2 hours after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated (not reset token itself).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if active, set when reset is used or expired.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification token for customer registration confirmation. Each token is a single-use, time-limited string issued when a customer registers, requiring verification before account activation. Tied to a customer account and expires after short duration. This is a session-type table capturing ephemeral authentication state.

Referenced by: shopping_mall_customers (via customer_id).
Linked to: customer account lifecycle.

Automatically deleted upon successful verification or expiration. No audit or versioning required as per business rule.

Note: Not a snapshot or primary entity - purely a transient verification mechanism for actor authentication flow.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belongs to customer account. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token. Generated as cryptographically random string.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When this token expires. Must be enforced by the application to invalidate after short duration (typically 1 hour).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the verification request was issued. Automatically generated by system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this record. Used for internal system consistency.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification was successfully completed. Null until verified.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Main table for registered seller accounts with email/password authentication credentials. This is an actor entity that represents a business entity capable of listing products, managing inventory, fulfilling orders, and interacting with customer inquiries. Sellers require distinct authentication flow and identity separate from customers. All profile metadata (shop name, description, logo) are preserved immutably via snapshots in shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots; this table contains only authentication and identity lifecycle data. Never contains editable profile fields - those are managed by snapshot system to ensure transactional integrity.

This table is never referenced by any child table with a foreign key pointing to it. Instead, child tables like shopping_mall_seller_sessions, shopping_mall_seller_password_resets, and shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications reference this table using foreign keys in the direction child→parent.

Seller status (pending, approved, rejected) is managed as a plain field to reflect onboarding state, not as a separate table because it represents the lifecycle state of the actor identity rather than a business entity relationship. Suspension (suspended_at) is a temporal flag for account management.

All fields are non-nullable except deleted_at and suspended_at, following soft-delete pattern. The email must be unique to ensure singular identity per account. Password_hash stores bcrypt hash, not plaintext.

All timestamps are stored as UTC with timezone and use ISO 8601 format at application layer.

See also: shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots (for immutable profile changes), shopping_mall_seller_sessions (for authentication sessions), shopping_mall_seller_password_resets (for recovery workflows).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication and communication. Must be valid email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt hash of the seller's password. Never stored as plaintext. Used for authentication during login.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the seller account is active and permitted to perform actions. Defaults to true. Set to false only on deletion or suspension.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Onboarding status of the seller: 'pending' (registration submitted), 'approved' (verified and active), or 'rejected' (denied by admin). Immutable after initial set.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by admin when seller registration is rejected. Preserved in audit trail but not displayed to seller after approval.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller account was created. Immutable and set at registration.

plainFields.name: approved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller registration was approved by admin. Null until approved.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, account is active. If set, account is logically deleted and login disabled. Account data preserved for historical audit.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller account was suspended by admin. Null if not suspended. Suspended sellers cannot list new products or process orders.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for seller authentication with access and refresh tokens.

This table tracks active login sessions for sellers. Each session is tied to a single seller and includes connection metadata for security auditing.

Session records are append-only and automatically expired after 30 minutes for access tokens or 30 days for refresh tokens. They are never updated—only created and deleted.

Reference: @\link shopping_mall_sellers.id

Not used for direct user operations—managed only by authentication service.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller's account this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client's IP address used to establish this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Complete URL path the user was visiting when initiating this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Original URL the user came from before entering the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created (ISO 8601 UTC).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires (ISO 8601 UTC). Always set to 30 minutes or 30 days after creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description:
Temporary password reset tokens for seller account recovery. Each token is unique, time-limited, and single-use. Expires 1 hour after creation. Associated with a specific seller account via foreign key. Tokens are invalidated after use or expiration and not soft-deleted.

This table is a session entity that supports the authentication flow described in 02-user-actors.md: when a seller requests password reset, a unique token is issued and stored here. The seller clicks the reset link containing the token, which validates the session and allows password change. After use, the token is removed from the system.

This table is a child of shopping_mall_sellers (actor). Seller accounts can have zero or more password reset requests over time. Each request is an ephemeral session. It is NOT a user profile, product, order, or review - it is purely an authentication event.

Relates to: {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller account that requested this password reset. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique, cryptographically random reset token. Expires after 1 hour.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Absolute timestamp when this token expires. Mandatory, not null. Must be exactly 1 hour after created_at.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset request was issued. Mandatory, not null.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token was successfully consumed to reset password. Null until used.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for seller registration confirmation. Used to validate seller email address during account registration. Once used, the token becomes invalid. Tokens expire after 24 hours for security. This table is append-only and never modified, ensuring immutability and auditability of email verification events.

Each record is tied to exactly one seller account via seller_id. When a seller registers, a record is created. When the seller clicks the verification link, the used flag is set to true. Expired or used tokens are eventually purged by system jobs. No data is deleted — only soft-deleted via deleted_at for compliance.

Never used for password reset or other purposes. Exclusive to email verification for seller sign-up.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller account that requested this email verification. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique cryptographic token generated for email verification link. Never reused.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires. Must be 24 hours after creation. Enforced by application logic and system cleanup jobs.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Indicates if the verification token has been successfully used to confirm the seller's email address. Once true, this token is invalid for future use.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification request was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was marked as used. Zeroed initially, then set to current time when used.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Used for compliance and audit trail retention. Records are never physically deleted, only marked as deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description: Main table for system administrators with email/password authentication credentials. Represents a distinct actor type with elevated permissions. Administrators control seller approvals, category management, order oversight, and user management. Each admin has a unique email and password_hash. Admin accounts may be suspended but not deleted. Soft-deletion via deleted_at is supported. Session management, password resets, and email verifications are handled by separate actor-specific tables (shopping_mall_admin_sessions, shopping_mall_admin_password_resets, shopping_mall_admin_email_verifications).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for login and communication. Must be verified during registration.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plaintext. Generated using secure hashing algorithm (bcrypt).

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates if the admin account is active and able to log in. Default is true.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Administrative status of the account: 'active', 'suspended', or 'deleted'. Used to control system access independently of is_active flag.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Required and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last modified. Updated on any profile change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the account is logically deleted but preserved for audit. Null means active.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was suspended. Null means not suspended. Used to track suspension history and duration.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication with access and refresh tokens. Tracks active login sessions for admin actors, storing connection metadata such as IP address, browser referrer, and session endpoints. This table is append-only and never modified after creation. Each session is tied to exactly one admin via admin_id, enforcing 1:N relationship. Sessions expire automatically and are invalidated upon logout or timeout.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: References the admin actor who initiated this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the client device at login time.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page where the admin logged in, including query parameters.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the admin navigated to the login page. May be empty if directly accessed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created. Always in UTC.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session will expire. Set at login based on token longevity. Never nullable - enforced for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens issued to administrators for account recovery. Each token is one-time use, has a fixed expiration, and tracks the IP and user agent of the reset request. Immutable audit trail that ensures security and compliance.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who requested the password reset. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique cryptographic token generated for password reset. Must be stored securely and used only once.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token expires. After this time, the token is invalid and cannot be used.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used to reset the password. Null until first use.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string of the client device that initiated the password reset request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated (e.g., when token was used).

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for administrator registration confirmation. Used to verify email ownership during admin account registration. Each token is valid for a limited time and can only be used once. This table is part of the authentication infrastructure for admin actors and follows the same pattern as customer and seller email verification systems.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account this verification token belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: The administrator's email address being verified. This is stored here for audit purposes, though the primary identity is in shopping_mall_admins.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this verification token. After this time, the token is invalid and must be re-requested.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token was created and sent.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this email was successfully verified. Null until verification occurs.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token generated for this email verification request.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Product categories for hierarchical organization of products, with optional parent-child relationships and soft delete support.

Categories enable structured navigation and product classification. Each category may belong to a parent category to create multi-level hierarchies (e.g., Electronics > Computers > Laptops). Admins manage category names, descriptions, and hierarchy. Deleted categories are soft-deleted to preserve product associations in historical data. No product or variant snapshots are stored here — these are handled by independent components.

Used in: Product catalog lookup, storefront navigation, filtering, and search.

@link shopping_mall_products.category_id

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category in hierarchical structure. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique, human-readable name of the category (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Clothing'). Must be unique across all categories.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's contents or purpose. Optional field for additional context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last edited.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted. Null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_variants
models.description: Junction table linking product snapshots to their variant snapshots at time of product edit, preserving variant state context. This table does not store business data — it is purely a reference for reconstructing the exact variant state included in a product snapshot during an edit operation. Used for historical reconstruction during audit or dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: References the product snapshot record that includes this variant state. {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id}.

foreignFields.name: variant_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: References the immutable variant snapshot at the time of product edit. {@link shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots.id}.

models.name: shopping_mall_users
models.description: Unified identity table for customers, sellers, and administrators. Serves as the root authentication entity. Each record represents a unique actor with email/password credentials. User type is discriminated by 'user_type' field (customer/seller/admin), but profile-specific data (name, shop, roles) are stored in domain-specific tables to adhere to 3NF and snapshot principles. This table is never updated for profile changes — only soft-deleted or archived. All authentication session records reference this table.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication. Must be valid and unique across all actors.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt hash of the user's password. Never store plain text.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates if the account is active and can log in. Set to false on deletion or suspension.

plainFields.name: user_type
plainFields.description: Discriminator for actor type: 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'. Determines which domain table (shopping_mall_customers, shopping_mall_sellers, shopping_mall_admins) holds profile data.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the account. Valid values: 'active', 'suspended', 'deleted'. For actors: 'deleted' means account-level soft deletion, not data purge.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was registered. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last authentication or status change. Updated on password change or suspend.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If set, account is considered logically deleted and cannot authenticate.

models.name: shopping_mall_products

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns and manages this product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Primary category this product belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The current name of the product as displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: The current full description of the product, including features and specifications.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: The current base price of the product, before variant-specific pricing overrides.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created in the catalog.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was logically deleted. NULL means active. Used for soft delete compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutably preserved versions of product metadata at time of change. Each snapshot captures the exact state of a product (name, description, category, base price) whenever a seller or admin makes an edit. Used for audit trail, legal compliance, and dispute resolution. References live product and category through foreign keys, preserving historical context. Never modified after creation.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the live product being snapshotted. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product's category at time of snapshot. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

foreignFields.name: changed_by_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the actor (customer, seller, or admin) who created this snapshot. {@link shopping_mall_users.id}.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Sequential integer representing the version number of this snapshot. Starts at 1 for the first snapshot after product creation and increments on every edit.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, capturing the exact moment of the product edit.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Multiple images associated with each product, trackable by position and deletion status. Images are managed exclusively through the parent product entity and do not have independent API endpoints. Each image is stored as a single record with immutable URL and position ordering. Deletion is soft-deleted to preserve historical accuracy for product snapshots.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL path to the stored image file. Immutable once saved.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Order position of the image in the product's image gallery. Used for display sequence. Minimum value: 0.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was first uploaded and recorded in the system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was logically deleted. Null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Product variants with unique SKU codes, pricing overrides, and stock quantities. Each variant represents a distinct product configuration (e.g., color, size) and is linked to a specific product. Variants are immutable in historical orders through snapshots. This is a primary entity with independent CRUD operations and direct API endpoints for sellers to manage.

Relates to: shopping_mall_products (one-to-many). Variants are created, edited, and deleted by sellers. Each variant has a unique SKC code (SKU) used for inventory tracking. Stock quantity is updated via inventory_logs on order, restock, cancellation, or refund.

Cannot be deleted if any order item exists in 'paid' or 'shipped' status. Must preserve all variant snapshots via shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots.

Reference: 04-product-management.md, 05-inventory-handling.md, 12-snapshot-principle.md

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this variant belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code for this variant. Must be alphanumeric, 3-20 characters. Unique across all variants.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Optional price override for this variant. If null, uses product's base_price. Must be zero or greater.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current inventory quantity for this variant. Updated by inventory_logs when order is placed, restocked, cancelled, or refunded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, variant is active. If set, variant is deleted and cannot be purchased.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots of product variant states (SKU, price) at time of modification, versioned for audit. Each record captures the exact SKU code and price of a variant at the moment it was edited by a seller or admin. Maintains a full history of changes with versioning, enabling precise reconstruction of product pricing and configuration history for dispute resolution, compliance, and financial auditing. This table never updates or deletes records - only appends new versions. All fields are preserved exactly as they existed at the time of change, including previous values for comparison.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant being snapshot. References the live variant in shopping_mall_product_variants.

foreignFields.name: changed_by
foreignFields.description: The actor who modified the variant (seller or admin). References shopping_mall_sellers or shopping_mall_admins.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Sequential version number indicating order of changes. Starts at 1 for first snapshot after variant creation.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: The exact SKU code of the variant at the time of this snapshot.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: The exact price of the variant at the time of this snapshot, in decimal currency format.

plainFields.name: previous_sku_code
plainFields.description: The SKU code of the variant before this change. Null for first snapshot.

plainFields.name: previous_price
plainFields.description: The price of the variant before this change. Null for first snapshot.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was modified and this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created in database.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this snapshot record (always same as created_at due to immutability).

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_logs
models.description:
Immutable history of all inventory changes: restocks, order deductions, cancellations, refunds, and manual adjustments. Each record represents a single atomic change to variant stock quantity, with reason, timestamp, and optional reference to origin (e.g., order item). This is a pure event log, not a state table. No modification or deletion is ever allowed. Query pattern: retrieve all changes for a variant ordered by timestamp DESC. Used by application layer to calculate real-time stock levels.

This table enforces First Normal Form: every field is atomic. All relationships are through foreign key variant_id. Never stores product name, price, or seller info — only variant_id and change.

Examples:
- A customer purchases 2 units → change_quantity: -2, reason: "order", reference_id: "ord_item_abc"
- Seller restocks 10 units → change_quantity: +10, reason: "restock", reference_id: null
- Cancellation approved → change_quantity: +1, reason: "cancellation", reference_id: "ord_item_abc"
- Admin manually adjusts → change_quantity: +3, reason: "adjustment", reference_id: null

foreignFields.name: variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant that experienced the inventory change. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: change_quantity
plainFields.description: The quantity change. Positive for restock or refund, negative for order or depletion. Must never be zero.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The business reason for this inventory change. Must be one of: 'restock', 'order', 'cancellation', 'refund', 'adjustment', 'loss'. Defined by business rules in 05-inventory-handling.md.

plainFields.name: reference_id
plainFields.description: Optional reference to the source that triggered this change. For example: order_item_id for order/refund/cancellation, or adjustment_id for manual changes. When null, change was initiated by seller or admin without a direct order reference.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive notes about the change, e.g., 'Batch #A123 restocked', 'Lost in transit'. Used primarily for internal admin context. Never used for calculation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory event was recorded. Always in UTC.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. For audit logs, this is typically identical to created_at since records are immutable.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Container table that groups a customer's active cart items. Associates customer with their current cart session. This table does not store product or variant data - those are stored in shopping_mall_cart_items. Each customer has at most one active cart.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cart was last modified (e.g., when items were added or removed).

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description: Individual item in a customer's shopping cart, capturing immutable snapshot data of product, variant, and seller profile as they existed at the moment of addition to cart. This table ensures that pricing, product description, variant options, and seller identity are preserved exactly as the customer saw them, even if those details change later. This table is a subsidiary entity — it has no independent existence outside the cart context and is automatically consumed during checkout to create order items. No user interacts with cart items directly; they are always managed through the cart container (shopping_mall_carts).

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who added this item to cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: variant_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant at time of addition. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Immutable snapshot of the product state (name, description, category, base price, images) as it appeared at time of cart addition. {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id}.

foreignFields.name: variant_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Immutable snapshot of the variant state (SKU, price override) as it appeared at time of cart addition. {@link shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who listed the product at time of cart addition. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. This replaces non-existent seller_profile_snapshot_id. Seller name/logo are immutable actor attributes stored in shopping_mall_sellers.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this variant added to cart. Must be ≥1.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Exact unit price of the variant at the time it was added to cart, copied from snapshot.

plainFields.name: item_total
plainFields.description: Total price for this cart item (quantity × unit_price). Calculated at addition time and preserved for audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the cart. Always immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was last modified (e.g., quantity changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, item is still in cart. If set, item has been removed from cart.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Root record of a completed purchase transaction with fixed pricing and shipping address snapshot. This is an immutable financial record that cannot be altered after creation. Order status is derived from its order items and must be tracked via shopping_mall_order_status_histories. All product, variant, and seller details are preserved as snapshots in shopping_mall_order_items and shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots, not duplicated here. This table serves as the anchor for order-level reporting, financial reconciliation, and customer order history.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shipping_address_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's shipping address chosen at checkout. Stored as a reference to the customer record, since shopping_mall_addresses does not exist. Per 02-user-actors.md, customer addresses are managed as a collection within shopping_mall_customers. This reference identifies the selected address from the customer's address list, not as direct foreign key to a separate address table.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total order amount at time of checkout, including tax but excluding discounts. Stored as immutable snapshot value. Never recalculated.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the entire order, derived from its order items: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, partially_completed. Immutable after assignment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment was confirmed and order was created. Always in UTC.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last status change to this order, triggered by order item status update. Always in UTC.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description: Individual line items within an order, each linked to immutable product, variant, and seller snapshots at time of purchase. This table anchors financial accountability: every price, product description, variant option, and seller profile shown to the customer at checkout is permanently recorded here regardless of subsequent edits. No updates allowed after creation — the snapshot reference ensures audit trail integrity for disputes, refunds, and compliance. This is a primary entity with independent CRUD access for administrators to audit, filter by status, and reconcile inventory.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent order this item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who listed the product at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product referenced at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Specific product variant chosen by customer at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Immutable snapshot of product state (name, description, base price) at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_product_snapshots.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Immutable snapshot of variant state (SKU, price override) at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased. Always ≥1.

plainFields.name: price_at_time_of_purchase
plainFields.description: Unit price of variant exactly as it was at time of purchase. Never recalculated. Used for revenue tracking and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of this order item. Must be one of: 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'refunded'. Defined by 07-order-management.md.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was created at the time of order placement.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last status change event for this item.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Only set if item is purged for compliance reasons (never in normal operation).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshot of product, variant, and seller state captured at the exact moment of order creation. This record preserves the exact product name, description, category, base price, and images; variant SKU, option values, and price; and seller profile name, description, and logo—at the time of purchase. Used for dispute resolution, audit trails, and legal compliance, ensuring that all transaction data remains unaltered forever. This snapshot is referenced by order_item and never updated after creation.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order item that this snapshot belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product ID as it existed at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant ID as it existed at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller ID as it existed at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: product_name
plainFields.description: Exact product name as it appeared at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: product_description
plainFields.description: Exact product description as it appeared at the time of purchase.

plainFields.name: category_id
plainFields.description: Category ID as it existed at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: category_name
plainFields.description: Exact category name as it appeared at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product as it existed at time of purchase, in decimal format.

plainFields.name: thumbnail_image_url
plainFields.description: URL of the primary product image as it appeared at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: all_product_images
plainFields.description: JSON array of all product image URLs as they existed at time of purchase, in order.

plainFields.name: variant_sku
plainFields.description: Exact SKU code of the variant as it existed at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: variant_price
plainFields.description: Price override of the variant as it existed at time of purchase, in decimal format (nullable if no override).

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: JSON object containing all option name-value pairs (e.g., {"color": "red", "size": "large"}) as they existed at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: stock_at_time_of_purchase
plainFields.description: Stock quantity of the variant at the exact time of purchase.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Exact shop name of the seller as it appeared at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Exact shop description of the seller as it appeared at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: logo_image_url
plainFields.description: Logo URL of the seller’s profile as it appeared at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created (matches order creation time).

plainFields.name: snapshot_hash
plainFields.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the entire snapshot data for integrity verification.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_histories
models.description: Immutable audit trail of all status transitions for the entire order, recording who and when each change occurred at the order level. This table captures every transition (paid → shipped → delivered → cancelled → refunded → partially_completed) with the previous state, new state, actor responsible, timestamp, and optional reason for audit and compliance. Designed to support administrative oversight and dispute resolution per 07-order-management.md.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: References the parent order that changed status. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: The previous order status before the change. One of: 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'refunded', 'partially_completed'.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The new order status after the change. One of: 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'refunded', 'partially_completed'.

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: Who triggered the status change. One of: 'system', 'customer', 'seller', 'admin'.

plainFields.name: timestamp
plainFields.description: Exact timestamp when the status change occurred, in UTC.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional brief reason for the status change, e.g., 'Automatically marked as delivered after 14 days', 'Customer requested cancellation', 'Admin overridden'. Max 500 characters.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description: Represents a physical shipment created by a seller containing one or more order items. Captures carrier and tracking number at time of shipment creation. This is a primary business entity allowing independent tracking and management of physical deliveries. Each shipment links to a single order and seller, enabling accountability and logistical visibility. The shipment record is permanent and immutable and does not represent financial state or inventory changes — those are captured in order and inventory components.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order that this shipment is fulfilling. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who created and shipped this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: The name of the carrier or courier service handling this shipment (e.g., FedEx, UPS, local postal).

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: The unique tracking number assigned by the carrier for this shipment. Used by customers to track delivery progress.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this shipment was created and dispatched by the seller.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this shipment record was initially created in the system. Matches shipped_at for consistency.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this shipment record was last updated. Typically only updated when tracking status is manually synced or corrected.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_items
models.description: Junction table that associates each order item with a specific shipment. Enforces that each order item belongs to exactly one shipment. This table does not store any business data, only foreign key relationships to maintain the 1:1 relationship between order_item_id and shipment_id as required by the shipping workflow. Every shipment item represents an order item that has been included in a physical shipment. This table is immutable after insertion.

foreignFields.name: shipment_id
foreignFields.description: References the parent shipment entity. This foreign key defines which shipment this order item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: References the order item being shipped. Unique constraint ensures one order item is associated with only one shipment. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description: Customer reviews with rating, content, and deletion status. Each review is tied to a specific order item to enforce eligibility (only delivered items may be reviewed). Reviews are independently managed entities, allowing customers to create, edit, and delete feedback, while maintaining audit trails via snapshots in shopping_mall_review_snapshots. This table captures the active state of reviews and serves as the source for display and moderation, with immutable historical records preserved in the snapshot table.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who wrote the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item that qualifies this review. Must be linked to a delivered order item. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Customer's rating from 1 to 5 (inclusive). Required for review submission.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional textual feedback provided by the customer.

plainFields.name: is_deleted
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the review has been logically deleted by customer or admin. True if deleted, false if active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated. Updated on edit or deletion.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was logically deleted. Nullable; if null, review is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_snapshots
models.description: Immutable historical snapshots of review changes including previous rating, content, and deletion status, with change timestamps and actor who made the change. Each snapshot represents a point-in-time state of a review's content and status (including deletion status). This table preserves full revision history for audit, dispute resolution, and integrity verification. New rows are added whenever a review is edited (up to 500 characters) or deleted, always preserving previous state values. Related to shopping_mall_reviews via review_id. Read-only for customers and administrators.

foreignFields.name: review_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original review in shopping_mall_reviews. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: The review's rating (1-5) at the time this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: The review's text content at time of this snapshot. Null if review was created with no content.

plainFields.name: is_deleted
plainFields.description: The deletion status of the review at the time of this snapshot (true if deleted at that moment).

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp when this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: Actor who triggered the change: either 'customer' or 'admin'.

plainFields.name: previous_rating
plainFields.description: Previous rating value before this change. Null if this is the first snapshot.

plainFields.name: previous_content
plainFields.description: Previous content value before this change. Null if this is the first snapshot or previous content was null.

plainFields.name: previous_is_deleted
plainFields.description: Previous deletion status before this change. Null if this is the first snapshot.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_requests
models.description: Customer-initiated cancellation requests for order items, with pending/approved/rejected status and seller/admin response. Each request is tied to a specific order item and customer. When approved, triggers inventory restoration and order item status change to cancelled. Seller or admin must respond with approval or rejection and reason. All requests are immutable in their state after creation; changes are recorded in the snapshot table.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order item for which cancellation is requested. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who initiated the cancellation request. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: responder_id
foreignFields.description: The seller or admin who responded to this request. Null until response is made. {@link shopping_mall_users.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Text explanation provided by customer for requesting cancellation. Minimum 10 characters, maximum 500.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the cancellation request: 'pending', 'approved', or 'rejected'. Must be one of these three values.

plainFields.name: response_reason
plainFields.description: Text reason provided by seller or admin when approving or rejecting the request. Only populated when status is 'approved' or 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request status was last updated, e.g., when approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Requests are never permanently deleted, but soft-deleted if invalid or duplicate.

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshots of cancellation request state at each status change, for audit and historical reference. Captures the exact state of the cancellation request (reason, status, responder, response reason) whenever it transitions. All data is preserved forever. This table is write-once and read-only. Used by administrators and customers to resolve disputes about cancellation decisions. Every change to a cancellation request creates a new snapshot, preserving the previous state. Never updated or deleted.
- Each snapshot corresponds to exactly one cancellation request
- Versioned by chronological changed_at timestamp
- Status transitions: pending → approved/rejected
- Captures responder and reason for rejection/approval
- Does not duplicate product or order data - those are in OrderItem snapshots

foreignFields.name: cancellation_request_id
foreignFields.description: References the associated cancellation request. {@link shopping_mall_cancellation_requests.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The exact cancellation reason provided by the customer at the time of request.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The status of the cancellation request at the time of this snapshot. Must be one of: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: responder_id
plainFields.description: The ID of the seller or admin who responded to the request. Null if pending.

plainFields.name: response_reason
plainFields.description: The reason provided by the responder when approving or rejecting the request. Null if pending.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this snapshot was created (i.e., when the status changed).

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: The actor type that created this snapshot: 'customer' (when request created), 'seller' (when responding), or 'admin' (when overriding).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description: Customer-initiated refund requests for delivered order items with 7-day window. Records status, reason, timestamps, and responder. Immutable status flow: pending → approved/rejected. Preserves request context for audit and reconciliation.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item for which the refund is requested. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who initiated the refund request. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: responder_id
foreignFields.description: The seller or admin who responded to the refund request. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}. Nullable until resolved.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The reason provided by the customer for requesting the refund. Minimum 10 characters, maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request. Values: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'. Follows approval workflow.

plainFields.name: response_reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason provided by the responder. Required if status is 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request received a response. Nullable until resolved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The creation timestamp of the refund request.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The last update timestamp of the refund request.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots of refund requests at time of creation or resolution. Preserves state for audit, reconciliation, and compliance. Each row represents a versioned state of a refund request when it was created or changed (approved/rejected). This table has no direct user interaction — it is written only by system logic when a refund request is created or updated.

foreignFields.name: refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent refund request entity. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id}.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Incremental version number for this snapshot. Starts at 1 for initial creation and increments on each status change. Used to order historical states chronologically.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: The customer's reason for request as provided at time of snapshot creation or update.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The status of the refund request at the time this snapshot was taken. Must be one of: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: responder_id
plainFields.description: The ID of the actor (seller or admin) who responded to the request. Must be null if status is 'pending'.

plainFields.name: response_reason
plainFields.description: The seller's or admin's reason for approving or rejecting the request. Must be null if status is 'pending'.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when this snapshot was created or updated. Must be the exact moment the state changed (creation, approval, or rejection).

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: Actor type responsible for the change that triggered this snapshot. Must be one of: 'customer' (for creation), 'seller', or 'admin'.
